// Wiki — docs lint and site build, on Jenkins.
//
// Equivalent to .github/workflows/wiki.yml. Use ONE or the other depending on the
// repository; the verified command is the same in both, so behavior doesn't diverge.
//
// HOW TO USE
//   a) Repo with only Jenkins: rename this to `Jenkinsfile` (or point the job at
//      this path) and delete the GitHub Actions workflow.
//   b) A Jenkinsfile already exists: copy the `Wiki lint` and `Docs in sync` stages
//      into it.
//
// PREREQUISITES
//   - Multibranch Pipeline (or Branch Source): this is what sets CHANGE_TARGET on
//     PR builds. Without it, the gate doesn't know what to compare against — export
//     WIKI_BASE on the job instead.
//   - Node 20+ on the agent. Below via a Docker agent; if you prefer the NodeJS
//     plugin, swap for `agent any` + `tools { nodejs 'node-24' }`.

pipeline {
    // The lint doesn't need npm install or node_modules — only the Node binary
    // (npx fetches wiki-kit itself). That's why the slim image is enough and the
    // stage costs seconds.
    agent {
        docker {
            image 'node:24-alpine'
            args '-u root:root'
            reuseNode true
        }
    }

    options {
        timeout(time: 15, unit: 'MINUTES')
        disableConcurrentBuilds(abortPrevious: true)
    }

    stages {
        stage('History') {
            // Staleness and `--affected` compare commits. Many Jenkins agents
            // clone shallow (only the build's branch, depth 1), so the base
            // branch might not even exist locally. Without this stage the gate
            // would fail saying the base ref doesn't exist — which is the
            // correct behavior, but better to bring in the history and verify.
            when { expression { env.CHANGE_TARGET } }
            steps {
                sh '''
                    set -eu
                    apk add --no-cache git >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
                    git config --global --add safe.directory "$PWD"
                    git fetch --no-tags --depth=200 origin \
                        "+refs/heads/${CHANGE_TARGET}:refs/remotes/origin/${CHANGE_TARGET}"
                '''
            }
        }

        stage('Wiki lint') {
            // Front matter, missing source, staleness, broken link.
            // Runs on every build, including branch builds.
            steps {
                sh 'npx -y @glauberborges/wiki-kit lint'
            }
        }

        stage('Docs in sync with the code') {
            // The gate: code changed and the page declaring it as a source didn't.
            // PR only — a branch build has no base to compare against.
            //
            // The base is resolved automatically from CHANGE_TARGET (wiki-kit
            // knows the env vars for Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab, and
            // Bitbucket), so there's no need to pass --base here.
            when { expression { env.CHANGE_TARGET } }
            steps {
                sh 'npx -y @glauberborges/wiki-kit affected --strict'
            }
        }

        stage('Build the site') {
            // The only stage that needs npm install. This is where Docusaurus's
            // `onBrokenLinks: throw` actually fails the build.
            when {
                anyOf {
                    changeset 'wiki/**'
                    branch 'main'
                    branch 'master'
                }
            }
            steps {
                sh '''
                    set -eu
                    npx -y @glauberborges/wiki-kit llms
                    npm --prefix wiki ci --no-audit --no-fund
                    npm --prefix wiki run build
                '''
            }
            post {
                success {
                    archiveArtifacts artifacts: 'wiki/build/**', allowEmptyArchive: true, fingerprint: false
                }
            }
        }
    }

    post {
        failure {
            echo 'Docs stale? Run locally: make -C wiki ingest-prompt'
        }
    }
}

// NOTES
//
// Shallow clone and depth. `--depth=200` covers most PRs. If a PR branches off a
// base that's much older, the merge-base can fall outside that window and the
// diff comes out larger than the real one (more pages flagged, never fewer — the
// gate errs on the safe side). If that happens, increase the depth or turn off
// shallow cloning in the job configuration.
//
// Without Multibranch Pipeline there's no CHANGE_TARGET: export WIKI_BASE on the
// job (`environment { WIKI_BASE = 'origin/develop' }`) so the gate knows the base.
//
// Agent without Docker: swap the `agent` block for `agent any` plus
// `tools { nodejs 'node-24' }` (NodeJS plugin, configured under Global Tool
// Configuration) and remove the `apk add` from the History stage.
